blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Galeries Tower survived Akari in five sets, 25-22, 26-24, 23-25, 15-25, 15-10, to finally capture its first win in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Erika Deloria put an end to the HighRisers’ woes after losing their first four games, dropping 20 points, 28 excellent receptions, and 11 digs. Galeries flirted with disaster, blowing a two-set lead and a 23-22 advantage in the third set, as Akari scored three straight to steal the frame and dominated the fourth to force a decider.
